To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

prospective motion correction with partial Fourier and/or parallel imaging reconstruction can be achieved by binning the k-space data into position bins based on the motion measurements, processing the data in each position bin, and combining the position bin data.

prospective motion correction with partial Fourier imaging and parallel imaging can be performed by binning the data based on the position of the subject during the scan and then processing the binned data using intrabin parallel imaging, intrabin phase correction, and intrabin coil combination.

a practical method for parallel and partial Fourier imaging reconstruction with prospective motion correction can be achieved through data-driven, noniterative, binning of the data based on motion measurements.

the problem of reconstructing images acquired with parallel imaging and/ or partial Fourier imaging when prospective motion correction is used.
the reconstruction of images acquired using parallel imaging and/or Fourier imaging with prospective correction for subject motion.
the problem of image reconstruction from data acquired with parallel imaging and prospective motion correction.
